title: U99 — Main <-> Timer Microprocessor (IC7501) TBUS Hang-Up
native_text: Communication error between Main CPU (AM34) and Timer MCU (IC7501)
translation: AM34 froze, failed initial TBUS handshake (<2s pre-watchdog), or halted in boot_panic_or_halt_7812 / BGO failure.
actions: Check elapsed time from PLEASE WAIT to U99: <=2s means AM34 crashed BEFORE FUN_44005cd0 set the 255s TBUS watchdog (check X_SW+3.8/+5.8/+12/3.3V rails, PFAIL[L], SA0..SA3, SDRAM, or TBUS).
Capture P7501 during Standby wakeup (`BOOTTRACE`/`PWRTRACE`) to verify if any serial bytes leave UARTP2M_T (Pin 6 -> Pico GP2 RX).

title: HELLO -> PLEASE WAIT (~2s) -> U99 Pre-Watchdog Boot Drop
native_text: Timer MCU cold boot (HELLO -> PLEASE WAIT -> U99 in <= 2s)
translation: IC7501 initialized volatile state (AC/TW7501 reset), energized DI_P_ON[H], and dropped to U99 before receiving AM34 TBUS 255s watchdog extension.
actions: Check whether UARTP2M_T (Pin 6) outputs Loader ver0.61/DDR CHECK during those 2s via Pico BOOTTRACE.
If silent (rxd_edges == 0 while NSW5V rises), inspect Digital PCB switched voltage rails, PFAIL[L], IC5001 SA0..SA3, and TBUS continuity.

title: BGO Driver Init Failed [1] (CS1 NOR BGO Partition Corrupted)
translation: bgo_driver_init() failed reading NOR CS1 [nfrom]/BGO partition (0x84200000..0x843FFFFF) and halted in boot_panic_or_halt_7812 -> U99.
actions: Use JIGPIN LOW (`SW_UART` Pin 1 LOW) + Open-Drain XRESET with a <=2GB FAT16 SDSC card holding patched DIGADIAG.FRM (`PROG061_PATCHED`) + PANA__SD.FRM.
Serial boot mode (`***** serial boot mode *****`) skips bgo_driver_init() and reaches PANAMON1>.

title: SDCD Error -91006 (4-Bit ACMD6/ACMD13 SD_STATUS Mismatch)
native_text: SD init / ACMD6 4-bit bus switch failure (-91006)
translation: BOOT.BIN requires SDSC <=2GiB card with all 4 DAT0..DAT3 lines intact across P6801/P6802 <-> P53501.
actions: Replace SDHC/SDXC (>2GiB) card with genuine <=2GiB SDSC formatted FAT16/FAT12 with DIGADIAG.FRM.
Inspect DAT1..DAT3 traces/resistors if genuine <=2GiB SDSC still logs -91006.

title: FAT_ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND (-10010)
translation: DIGADIAG.FRM missing from root directory or LFN-only entry.
actions: Copy DIGADIAG.FRM (131,072 B exact plaintext EXTRHEAD) cleanly into FAT16 root directory.

title: FAT_ERR_NO_FREE_FD (-10011)
native_text: FAT file descriptor table full or volume unmounted (-10011)
translation: Internal FAT FD table exhausted or mount lost before open.
actions: Power-cycle target and verify single-partition FAT16 layout on <=2GiB SDSC.

title: FAT_ERR_INVALID_ARG (-10020)
translation: Malformed 8.3 filename or out-of-range seek in BOOT.BIN FAT driver.
actions: Reformat card FAT16 with clean 8.3 uppercase filenames (`DIGADIAG.FRM`, `PANA__SD.FRM`).

title: FAT_ERR_INVALID_FS_OR_IO (-10025)
native_text: Bad MBR/BPB, FAT32 rejected, or SD sector read failure (-10025)
translation: BOOT.BIN rejected FAT32 / non-standard BPB geometry or failed SD block read.
actions: Format <=2GiB SDSC strictly as FAT16 (or run `panadiga unbrick verify-sd <DIR>` to validate BPB).

title: FAT_ERR_CORRUPT_CLUSTER (-10028)
translation: FAT table chain on SD card is corrupt or contains bad-cluster markers.
actions: Reformat SD card cleanly and copy freshly verified `DIGADIAG.FRM`.

title: FAT_ERR_EOF (-10030)
native_text: Unexpected EOF reading 0x20000 bytes of DIGADIAG.FRM (-10030)
actions: Regenerate exact 131,072-byte DIGADIAG.FRM via `panadiga unbrick prepare-sd`.

title: ODD Startup Error 80040904 (Sense 04/09/04 + Mecha 0x83A7)
translation: Head select / APC 0.5mW laser loop failure during optical drive self-test.
actions: Check 0.5mW laser diode APC, optical pickup ribbon cable, and top-cover interlock.
Bypass ODD/BGO via `serial boot mode` + `DIGADIAG.FRM` (`PANAMON1>`) to dump/verify flash without spin-up.

actions: Inspect 4-pin tray loading motor cable, belt, and leaf limit switch on R6-MV4 drive.
